summary.intent: Execute Phase 21 (BYO IPFS Node Support) across 7 plans in 4 waves, verify the implementation end-to-end including live migration between IPFS nodes, and plan gap closure for discovered issues.
summary.outcome: All 7 plans executed and verified; 6 bugs found and fixed during Playwright UAT; forward migration (CipherBox → external Kubo) confirmed working with 44/44 CIDs transferred; 4 gap closure plans (21-08 through 21-11) created for dual-pin upload wiring, TEE-routed connection test, Pinata support, and benchmark baselines.

repo: The migration trigger in StorageTab requires savedConfig to be non-null AND usedBytes > 0 AND provider changed — first-time users switching from default 'cipherbox' mode had null savedConfig so migration never fired
The TEE worker process does not load .env files automatically (no dotenv configured in index.ts) — env vars must be passed inline or exported in shell before starting
The tee-worker package is not part of the pnpm workspace (not in pnpm-workspace.yaml), requiring npm install instead of pnpm
The migration processor uses TEE_AUTH_SECRET while the TeeService uses TEE_WORKER_SECRET — different env var names for the same secret caused processor to be silently misconfigured
Pinata deprecated their standard PSA endpoint (/psa returns 404); they now use a proprietary /v3/files API incompatible with PsaProvider
Filebase RPC endpoint returns HTML error pages on /api/v0/id rather than standard Kubo JSON responses, despite advertising Kubo RPC support

The web app's upload flow goes through the CipherBox API relay (POST /ipfs/add), not through the SDK client — so DualPinProvider in the SDK is never invoked during web uploads, making dual-pin effectively non-functional in the UI
Auth store is memory-only (no localStorage/sessionStorage persistence) — cannot inject auth state for Playwright tests, must go through full UI login flow
The test-login API endpoint creates auth methods in the DB; subsequent email OTP login for the same email hits a UQ_auth_methods_type_hash constraint violation
Kubo nodes default to binding API on 127.0.0.1:5001, not 0.0.0.0 — must explicitly configure Addresses.API to expose to Docker network bridge
Hot-reload (Nest watch mode) does not terminate old process on port conflicts — EADDRINUSE leaves old PID holding port 3000, so recompiled code never actually runs

code.finding: Migration trigger condition requires savedConfig to be non-null, excluding first-time users. Fix: treat null savedConfig as implicit 'cipherbox' mode (previousMode defaults to 'cipherbox' when no IPNS record exists)
Uses process.env.TEE_AUTH_SECRET but the env var is set as TEE_WORKER_SECRET elsewhere — processor silently fails to connect to TEE worker

decryptEcies decodes ciphertext as base64 (Buffer.from(encryptedBase64, 'base64')) but StorageTab encrypts and sends as hex string (bytesToHex) — encoding mismatch causes 'bad point: got length 65' ECIES decryption failure
SSRF validation blocks all 192.168.* addresses, which prevents testing with Docker-network-hosted Kubo nodes in local dev. Simulator mode bypass needed for development
parseProviderConfig only handles 'psa' | 'kubo' protocol types — 'cipherbox' protocol (used when migrating FROM CipherBox-managed storage) causes a type error and missing fetch logic

Non-200 responses from Kubo/PSA probes (including 401/403/422) fell through to 'could not detect protocol' rather than reporting auth failure — CORS-blocked SaaS endpoints and wrong credentials showed same error as missing endpoints

workflow: GSD wave-based parallel execution works well — plans 21-01 and 21-02 ran concurrently with no conflicts since they touch different packages (sdk-core vs api)
Playwright MCP + email OTP is the most reliable Playwright auth path for this project since wallet mock requires complex setup and test-login creates DB conflicts with email auth
OTP can be retrieved from pnpm dev task output files at /private/tmp/claude-501/.../tasks/*.output — no need to ask the user or use complex grep strategies
Migration completion is best verified via direct DB/API query rather than UI polling — MigrationProgress component can show stale data from previous failed jobs
For integration debugging, spawning fresh background processes and tracking PIDs is critical — hot-reload is unreliable when port conflicts occur, always kill-by-port before restarting

friction: Docker host DHCP reassigned IP from 192.168.133.114 to 192.168.133.12 — required .env update for all 5 service references (PostgreSQL, Redis, IPFS) before dev stack would start
QEMU VM networking confusion: initially tried to ping the host from itself, took several probes to realize gateway (.2) was reachable but host's bridge IP had changed
Pinata PSA endpoint deprecated mid-implementation — documentation and the code both assumed /psa was valid; only discovered during live testing
Filebase IPFS RPC auth is non-standard — returns HTML error pages instead of JSON, making protocol detection impossible without direct debugging
TEE worker not loading .env required running it with inline env vars every time — no clear indication in the codebase that this was required
Multiple stale background API processes accumulating due to hot-reload EADDRINUSE errors, requiring manual kill-by-port interventions
Old failed migration job persisted in DB/Redis with 'completed' status, causing MigrationProgress to show stale '0/38 pins' even after triggering a new successful migration
Playwright auth was blocked twice: once by test-login creating duplicate auth methods, once by expired OTP between fill and submit
open_items: 21-08: Wire DualPinProvider into web app upload flow — currently only SDK has dual-pin logic but web app uploads bypass SDK and go directly to API relay
21-08: Add source unpin step after successful CID migration — current implementation is copy-only with no cleanup, leaving source provider with orphaned pins
21-09: Move connection test from browser-side to TEE-routed — browser CORS blocks all SaaS pinning providers; TEE should decrypt config in-enclave and probe endpoint server-side
21-10: Implement PinataProvider using Pinata's native /v3/files API — standard PSA and Kubo RPC are both unsupported by Pinata's current API
21-11: Capture BYO performance baselines in .planning/baselines/21-byo-baselines.md — requires real external IPFS provider credentials and stable infrastructure to run load scenarios
MigrationProgress component shows stale migration data on page load — should fetch fresh status on mount rather than relying on in-memory polling state
Reverse migration (external → cipherbox) had 1/45 CID failure — CID version mismatch (v0 vs v1) not handled in migration integrity check
TEE worker SSRF bypass for simulator mode is a dev-only workaround — production path still blocks 192.168.* and localhost correctly, but dev workflow requires explicit flag management
